in_sanskrit.name: विरेnd
in_sanskrit.meaning: one who has the power or ability to reach the end or limit of something
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वि (vi) - power, strength, or ability रे (re) - to reach, attain द (da) - end, limit, or boundary

in_hindi.name: विरेnd
in_hindi.long_meaning: वि (vi) - शक्ति, शक्तिपूर्ण (powerful, full of power) रे (re) - रहना (to reach, attain) द (da) - अंत (end)

in_tamil.name: விரேந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: வி (vi) - விருத்தம் (power) ரே (re) - இடம் (limit, boundary) த (da) - அவன் (he)

in_telugu.name: విరేంద
in_telugu.long_meaning: వి (vi) - శక్తి (power) రే (re) - పోయిపోయి (to reach, attain) ద (da) - ఎందుకు (end, limit)

in_marathi.name: Virend
in_marathi.long_meaning: Virend हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is Valiant, Brave and Fearless.

in_bengali.name: Virend
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Brave One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Virend একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is Valiant, Brave and Fearless.
